meaning: How a sourced profile becomes the tree a species' tuning starts from (fn-135). Each row maps one profile metric to one wire path through a code-owned formula: midpoint takes a range's middle, identity a single stated value, ratio a metric's middle times factor over another metric's middle or a value of the family's own. A row's condition reads the family's values only; no row names a species. Every appearance range keyed by a material field sets /material/<field> to its middle without a row. Code clamps each value to its dial's range in data/dials.json.

rows.basis: the envelope height is the tree's height in metres
the trunk radius is a share of the height; half the diameter at breast height stands in for the radius at the ground
spread is the crown's widest radius as a share of the height; a rosette's width is its fronds', not the envelope's
the rachis is the metres of frond the leaflets are strung along
a leaflet is the element, drawn at the canopy size times its own length
a leaflet is the element, drawn at the canopy size times its own width
a simple leaf is the element, drawn at the canopy size times its own length
a simple leaf is the element, drawn at the canopy size times its own width
